patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed dark backgrounds and lighter, off-white backgrounds, creating distinct visual breaks and grouping content.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings are used for primary messaging, contrasted with smaller, legible body text and very small, uppercase labels for categorization.
A deep, rich maroon/burgundy is used as a primary brand color for hero and key sections, paired with white text and a vibrant reddish-orange for calls to action.
Background elements in the hero section exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls down.
Content blocks and cards throughout the page are revealed with a staggered fade-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
Feature sections often use a grid layout of cards with images and descriptive text, consistently presenting information in digestible blocks.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image or video that subtly parallaxes behind the main heading and call to action as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth. Foreground content remains relatively fixed or moves at a slower rate.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes, are employed to reveal sections and individual content cards. As elements enter the viewport, they animate into place with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect, enhancing engagement without being overly distracting.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) are used for hero and section titles, with smaller, uppercase labels for categorization.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: The hero section is airy with generous vertical padding, while subsequent content sections maintain a balanced density with clear separation between blocks and elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich maroon/burgundy as a primary background color, paired with a clean, modern sans-serif typography and a vibrant red accent for CTAs, creates a sophisticated and bold aesthetic that feels premium and authoritative. The subtle parallax in the hero and scroll-triggered reveals add a polished, dynamic feel without overwhelming the user.
